name: dropdown-menu-43
description: App launcher that lays out menu items as a three-column grid of icon tiles.

files.content:
import { CalendarIcon, FileTextIcon, GripIcon, HardDriveIcon, MailIcon, MessageSquareIcon, SheetIcon, } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dropdown-menu" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const apps = [ { name: "Mail", icon: MailIcon, color: "text-sky-500" }, { name: "Calendar", icon: CalendarIcon, color: "text-rose-500" }, { name: "Drive", icon: HardDriveIcon, color: "text-amber-500" }, { name: "Docs", icon: FileTextIcon, color: "text-blue-500" }, { name: "Sheets", icon: SheetIcon, color: "text-emerald-500" }, { name: "Chat", icon: MessageSquareIcon, color: "text-violet-500" }, ] export default function AppLauncherGridMenu() { return ( } >
{apps.map((app) => ( {app.name} ))}
See all apps ) }
